tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Search Leafsight's plant problem guides: common symptoms, pests, diseases and care mistakes of houseplants and garden plants (for example yellow leaves, leaf spot, aphids, overwatering, root rot, powdery mildew). Use for general questions about a plant symptom. Returns titles, summaries and askleafs

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Read one Leafsight plant problem guide in full: what it looks like, common causes, what to do first, when to look closer, and its sources. Use a slug from search_guides. No sign-in needed.

tools.name: list_my_plants
tools.description: List the plants saved in the user's Leafsight account, each with its latest assessment and next check-in date, plus recent results not filed under a plant. A plant with said_goodbye_on did not make it and is no longer being cared for: its history is kept, and no care or check-in should be suggested

tools.name: get_plant
tools.description: One saved plant: its details and notes, its recent assessments with care steps (as available in the user's app), its next check-in and active care tasks. A plant with said_goodbye_on did not make it and is no longer being cared for: its history is kept, and no care or check-in should be suggested fo

tools.name: get_result
tools.description: One past assessment from the user's account: the likely problem, severity, symptoms, causes and care steps (as available in the user's app). Use a result_id from list_my_plants or get_plant. Requires the user's Leafsight sign-in.

tools.name: get_upcoming_checkins
tools.description: The user's scheduled plant check-ins, soonest first, marked overdue, due today or upcoming. Plants the user said goodbye to are left out. Set include_other_care to also list watering and treatment tasks. Requires the user's Leafsight sign-in.

tools.name: follow_plant
tools.description: Use this when the user says something like "save this plant to Leafsight and remind me to look at it again". Adds one plant to the user's Leafsight account (its name, optionally its species and a short note of what they were told to do) with one check-in a number of days from now. It does not assess
